notes.title: Skate Story Grinds a Monumental Win
notes.content:
Taking a sec to give ya'll an update on the game, and with tremendous news, it's great to share that [h2]I won at the prestigious [b]15th annual Devolver Delayed Awards 2024[/b]![/h2] 
First off, it's an absolute honor to have been nominated, and now that my cast is off and I can properly clap for my fellow nominees, I prefer not to.

[previewyoutube=OR366e-oKY4;full][/previewyoutube]
This win has been a critical moment of my game development/hospital visiting career, and something I will never, ever, forget. 

Catch you in 2025.

- Sam
